name: STA238H1 — Correction Attribution (Linear Models)
description: 'Linear regression assumes X is normal.' FALSE! Assumptions on ERRORS εᵢ: (1) E[εᵢ]=0. (2) Var(εᵢ)=σ². (3) Independent. (4) εᵢ~N(0,σ²) for inference.

steps.template_en: 'Linear regression assumes X is normal.' FALSE! Assumptions on ERRORS εᵢ: (1) E[εᵢ]=0. (2) Var(εᵢ)=σ². (3) Independent. (4) εᵢ~N(0,σ²) for inference.
steps.template_zh: '线性回归假设X正态。'错！假设在误差上：(1)E[εᵢ]=0。(2)Var(εᵢ)=σ²。(3)独立。(4)εᵢ~N(0,σ²)用于推断。

steps.template_en: Yᵢ=β₀+β₁Xᵢ+εᵢ. OLS: minimize Σ(Yᵢ-β₀-β₁Xᵢ)². β̂₁=Σ(Xᵢ-X̄)(Yᵢ-Ȳ)/Σ(Xᵢ-X̄)², β̂₀=Ȳ-β̂₁X̄. Gauss-Markov: OLS is BLUE.
R²=1-SS_res/SS_total. adjR² adjusts for predictors. F-test: all βⱼ=0. t-test: individual βⱼ=0. Residuals vs fitted: check homoscedasticity. Q-Q: check normality.
steps.template_zh: R²=1-SS_res/SS_total。F检验：所有βⱼ=0。t检验：单个βⱼ=0。残差vs拟合检查方差齐性。Q-Q检查正态性。

steps.template_en: Diagnostics MORE important than p-values. Check: (1) Linearity. (2) Constant variance. (3) Normality. (4) Independence. (5) Influential points (Cook's distance).
steps.template_zh: 诊断比p值更重要。检查：(1)线性。(2)常数方差。(3)正态性。(4)独立性。(5)影响点(Cook距离)。

steps.template_en: In R: lm(weight~height, data=women). (1) Interpret β̂₀, β̂₁. (2) Test H₀: β₁=0. (3) R². (4) Plot residuals. (5) Add quadratic: lm(weight~height+I(height²)). Does R² improve?
steps.template_zh: 在R中拟合线性模型：(1)解释β̂₀,β̂₁。(2)检验H₀:β₁=0。(3)R²。(4)残差图。(5)加二次项：R²改善了吗？

steps.template_en: Linear models are the FOUNDATION. Modern extensions: GLMs (logistic, Poisson), mixed models (random effects), GAMs (smooth terms), regularization (ridge, lasso). All BUILD on linear model framework.
steps.template_zh: 线性模型是基础。现代扩展：GLM、混合模型、GAM、正则化。都建立在线性模型框架上。
